cards.card_text: It's the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year.
cards.verse_text: These are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
cards.snippet: …are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah: In the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,

cards.card_text: It's the fourth year of King Darius of Persia (Ezra 4:24), and on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev, the word of the LORD comes to the prophet Zechariah.
cards.verse_text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
cards.snippet: …Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
